documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Msafe Equipments reported FY26 revenue of Rs 10,349.96 lakhs and an EBITDA margin of 39.49%, driven by its dual sales and rental business models. Management highlighted that IPO proceeds are being deployed to expand scaffolding manufacturing capacity by nearly 2x, with expanded capacity expected to be operational from May 2027. The company also entered the aluminium formwork segment with a planned annual production capacity of 500 tonnes. Looking ahead to FY27, management targets at least 50% revenue growth supported by capacity ramp-ups and rental-led expansion. Msafe Equipments held its H2 and FY26 earnings conference call, reporting revenue of 103.5 crores and an EBITDA margin of 39.49%.

guidance.claim: Management expects a growth momentum with a CAGR of approximately 50%.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, with the commissioning of new capacity, expansion into formwork, increasing rental penetration, and new product introductions, we expect a growth momentum with a CAGR of approximately 50%.

guidance.claim: In the first year of the formwork segment, the company has set a modest target of 30 to 40 crores.
guidance.quote: In the first year, we have set a modest target of 30-40 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian scaffolding market benefits from strong infrastructure spending, increasing safety compliance, and a shift from unorganized to organized players.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian scaffolding market continues to benefit from strong infrastructure spending, increasing safety compliance, and a structural shift from unorganized to organized players.

capex_expansion.claim: The rental business is expanding through Rs 6 crore capex to build 748 tonnes of specialized rental equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: Expanding rental business through ₹6 crore capex to build 748 tonnes of specialized rental equipment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered the formwork segment with a planned annual production capacity of 500 tonnes in the rented unit.
capex_expansion.quote: Planned annual production capacity of 500 Tonnes in the rented unit to support initial scale-up and customer acquisition

capex_expansion.claim: MS scaffolding capacity has reached approximately 6,285 tons through temporary facilities developed on rental premises.
capex_expansion.quote: I am also pleased to share that our MS scaffolding capacity has already reached approximately 6,285 tons through temporary facilities developed on rental premises.

capex_expansion.claim: The owned facility is expected to commence by May 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Post-commissioning of the owned facility, which is expected to commence by May 2027, we will strategically evaluate whether to continue with the temporary capacities depending on demand visibility, utilization levels, and operational efficiency at that time.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex including investment in rental assets and the new plant will be approximately 130 crores this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Including the investment in rental assets and the new plant, total capex will be approximately 130 crores this year.

margins_costs.claim: MS Scaffolding rental yield is 32% to 38% and Aluminium rental yield is 60% to 66%.
margins_costs.quote:

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations grew by approximately 45% year-on-year to 103.5 crores, while EBITDA increased by nearly 57% to 49.9 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Our revenue from operations grew by approximately 45% year-on-year to 103.5 crores, while EBITDA increased by nearly 57% to 49.9 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin improved to 39.49% compared to 36.55% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin improved to 39.49% compared to 36.55% in FY25, while the PAT margin expanded to 21.66%.

margins_costs.claim: In steel scaffolding sales, the gross margin is about 5 to 6 percent.
margins_costs.quote: In steel scaffolding sales, the gross margin is about 5-6%.

margins_costs.claim: In formwork, the company expects a gross margin of 10 to 15 percent.
margins_costs.quote: In formwork, we are expecting a gross margin of 10-15%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently operates across approximately 1,000 to 1,500 construction and infrastructure sites.
orders_capacity.quote: To put our scale into perspective, we currently operate across approximately 1,000 to 1,500 construction and infrastructure sites, which provides us with a significant advantage in cross-selling additional products and services to an already established customer base.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates with nearly 2,500 customers across all of India.
orders_capacity.quote: We are currently operating with nearly 2,500 customers at 1,000-1,500 different sites all over India.

orders_capacity.claim: The company served over 2,500 customers in a year across various projects.
orders_capacity.quote: Served 2,500+ customers in a year across infrastructure, construction, industrial maintenance, and commercial projects.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately 25% of IPO proceeds allocated towards building rental assets were utilized by FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: As a part of the rental business expansion strategy, we have already utilized approximately 25% of the IPO proceeds allocated towards building rental assets by FY26, while the remaining amount is expected to be utilized by the second half of FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has deployed approximately 11% of the IPO proceeds earmarked for the expansion of manufacturing and the rental business.
capital_allocation.quote: We have already deployed approximately 11% of the IPO proceeds earmarked for the expansion of manufacturing and the rental business, while the remaining amount is expected to be utilized in FY27.

risks_headwinds.claim: In the last 6 years, bad debts have been less than 2%.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the last 6 years, our bad debts have been less than 2%, which is very low compared to industry standards.

management_commitments.claim: The remaining amount of IPO proceeds allocated towards building rental assets is expected to be utilized by the second half of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: As a part of the rental business expansion strategy, we have already utilized approximately 25% of the IPO proceeds allocated towards building rental assets by FY26, while the remaining amount is expected to be utilized by the second half of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The owned facility is expected to commence by May 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Post-commissioning of the owned facility, which is expected to commence by May 2027, we will strategically evaluate whether to continue with the temporary capacities depending on demand visibility, utilization levels, and operational efficiency at that time.

management_commitments.claim: The remaining amount of IPO proceeds earmarked for the expansion of manufacturing and rental business is expected to be utilized in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We have already deployed approximately 11% of the IPO proceeds earmarked for the expansion of manufacturing and the rental business, while the remaining amount is expected to be utilized in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Partial expansion of aluminum scaffolding will start by December 2026, and it should be completely finished by May 2027.
management_commitments.quote: We will partially start by December 2026, and it should be completely finished by May 2027.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
